description: This Java source file defines the MessageOnlyLogFilter class, which implements the LogNode interface. The class acts as a filter in a logging chain, passing only the message content to the next node, omitting metadata like priority, tags, or Throwable information.

classes.description: A log node filter that passes only the message content downstream.
